summary: ZTO Express filed a US Form 6-K (a foreign private issuer current report) furnishing five Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns covering September 15–21, 2026, disclosing ongoing open-market buybacks of American depositary shares into August 2026. The filings itemize repurchases such as 73,128 ADSs at USD 22.98 on August 12, 218,268 at USD 22.89, 218,091 at USD 22.91, 218,381 at USD 22.88, 231,703 at USD 21.56, and further lots through August 24 near USD 21.22–21.49, each ADS equal to one Class A ordinary share. Shares are repurchased but not yet cancelled, leaving a cancellation overhang; no board recommendation, advisor, premium or close date is stated. Watch total program size, pace versus the 557.33M-share base, and cancellation timing affecting share count and WVR structure.
